locators: Trna, ch. 2 §§2.1–2.3.3, table 2.1 and fig. 2.7, discusses six-axis end-effector SCHUNK Mini58, wheel segmentation, label origin, worn tires and a poorly assembled wheel that a top view misses. See §5.4 for camera predictions versus manual outcomes. Both theses are linked in the record.
cleaning: Preserve ordered source rows. One idx is one wheel operation; published groups of four wheels share a pallet. No pallet ID is in this CSV. Counts are episodes, not necessarily independent experiments. Static label and meas_id checked within each contiguous idx. Label strings are reproduced exactly as deposited (record defines True as product OK). Invalid labels on days 3 and 4 retained as provenance only. For days 1 and 2 stored labels come from computer vision; days 5 and 6 are human-labelled. No per-sample contact or bias field.
time_and_units: No measured individual timestamps. A nominal 0.004 s interval is documented; span is (n–1) times that value. Summaries retain unconverted source channel values; the CSV lacks explicit units for these columns. Consecutive identical six-axis vectors count only within an episode. They are retained in all statistics and do not prove distinct force updates or dropped frames.
hash_convention: For within-release exact-episode comparisons, hash each ordered six-channel row encoded as six network-order IEEE 754 binary64 values. Filename SHA-256 and publisher MD5 refer to the original bytes.
recompute: Python 3 standard library: python derive_wheels.py ForceTorqueTimeSeries.csv OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
